fullDescription:
Yustika is a fashionable and sophisticated font that oozes glamour and luxury. With its elegant, elongated serifs and fine, delicate lines, this typeface is perfect for creating a high-end look in your designs. Use it for branding, editorial design, and other applications that require a touch of refinement and opulence.
This font is PUA encoded which means you can access all of the amazing glyphs and ligatures with ease!
